title: Omori Texure Pack
description: HIII i made a texture pack for omori! it replaces the sword with aubreys bat and the discs with the album photos and replaced some songs and all discs! and more
body: HIII i made a texture pack for omori! it replaces the sword with aubreys bat and the discs with the album photos and replaced some songs and all discs! it replaces the textures with the blacked out photos from basil photo album and also has lines from the games ending in the name and description of the discs!
